cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, in what order do extension prePopulate, onPopulate and postPopulate run relative to building child fields? Is onInit another name for one of these phases?
answer_checks: Explain prePopulate, onPopulate, child traversal, postPopulate; distinguish onInit field/component lifecycle.

cases.request: I have two Formly 6.3.12 extensions with priorities 3 and 1. Which runs first, and what priority applies if I omit it?
answer_checks: Ascending order: 1 before 3, omitted defaults to 1.

cases.request: For Formly 6.3.12, will registering my custom extension before the core setup make it run before all core extensions even if I leave its priority unset?
answer_checks: No registration-order guarantee; unspecified priority 1 and built-in negative priorities, lower numeric priority earlier within phases.

cases.request: In the Formly Material addons example, how does the extension avoid adding the same wrapper repeatedly when a field is rebuilt? Does this prove any extension is safe to rerun?
answer_checks: Conditional addon wrapper append with existing-wrapper guard; not universal rerun safety.

cases.request: For Formly 6.3.12, what setup enables named presets, and how does a field reference a preset called firstName?
answer_checks: FormlyPresetModule from @ngx-formly/core/preset, presets configuration, type #firstName; do not claim bare firstName automatically registered as rendering type.

cases.request: Can a Formly 6.3.12 preset use a getConfiguration provider instead of a literal configuration object? Is a provider mandatory?
answer_checks: getConfiguration provider supported alongside plain config object; provider not mandatory.

cases.request: At what build phase and priority does Formly 6.3.12 substitute a #name preset, and does that happen before core initialization or in onInit?
answer_checks: prePopulate priority -300 before core; not onInit.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, can I depend on a preset having already supplied its configuration when a normal priority-1 custom extension reaches prePopulate? Explain the relevant ordering.
answer_checks: Matching configured preset substituted in prePopulate at -300 before normal priority1; bounded to configured ordinary preset rather than universal recursive guarantee.

cases.request: If my Formly 6.3.12 extension adds an addons wrapper, is onInit the same as prePopulate, and can I assume repeated builds will never add a duplicate?
answer_checks: Distinct lifecycle/build hooks; use guarded conditional transformation, no automatic duplicate prevention for arbitrary extension.

cases.request: Does Formly 6.3.12 supporting #name presets and getConfiguration prove that recursive presets and arbitrary null overrides will work as I expect? What is actually established?
answer_checks: Establish named preset/provider and prePopulate substitution; explicitly decline general recursive composition or null override semantics.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, will my expressionChanges listener necessarily fire every time a string or function expression is checked even if its value stays unchanged?
answer_checks: No per-evaluation guarantee; cached function/string results can skip updates/emission. Do not claim every evaluation triggers an event.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, an address fieldGroup has key address and contains a city leaf. Does city field.model refer to the city string, address object, or root model?
answer_checks: Under the stated ordinary hierarchy, address field.model is keyed group value; city field.model is address scope, not city scalar or root.

cases.request: An internal Formly source file exports TypeOption. Does that make it a public @ngx-formly/core import in 6.3.12? Explain a public typing alternative.
answer_checks: Internal export not public package guarantee; TypeOption absent from public barrel; use ConfigOption-derived element type.
